text:
sam: deploy-bot blocked eu canary publish for service gateway
sam: build-tag: gateway:staging-20260322-35
deploy-bot: publish failed: attestation mismatch -> timestamp TTL not acceptable by eu provenance guard :x:
deploy-bot: details: cosign_attestation_missing=false, timestamp_valid=false, kms_region=eu-west-1
tina: saw this in the pipeline logs too. cosign produced an attestation, but the timestamp field is outside the allowed TTL window for eu checks
maria: is this a GCR vs ECR thing? CI pushed to eu.gcr.io and eu ECR mirror rejects it?
sam: we push to both. US pushes succeeded earlier; only EU mirror tripped the guard
tina: deploy-bot policy: stop promotion on provenance failures. It will not fall back automatically
maria: options: 1) manual pin to known-good digest, 2) regenerate attestation with correct TTL and republish, 3) abort change window and revert canary in eu.
sam: prefer manual pin to keep traffic flowing. we can republish during maintenance window (02:00-04:00 UTC)
deploy-bot: manual-promotion allowed with audit reason
maria: confirmed previous good digest: sha256:3a9b5c... (from last successful eu canary)
tina: I'll run the promote: `deployctl promote --service gateway --env eu-canary --image-digest sha256:3a9b5c... --reason "attestation TTL fail, temporary pin"`
sam: adding short note to release notes and the rollback playbook. include instructions not to re-trigger eu publish until republish window
release-bot: change window check: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC is open (auto-approved)
maria: created INF-9002 "eu cosign timestamp-ttl missing in wrapper" and assigned to tina
tina: adding a guard test to CI to fail early if cosign wrapper doesn't set `--timestamp-ttl`
sam: ran the manual promote, deploy-bot: eu canary pinned to sha256:3a9b5c... :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: logged audit entry and metric "canary_pin_manual"
maria: release note draft: "EU canary pinned to previous digest due to attestation timestamp TTL mismatch. A republish with corrected attestation will occur during maintenance window. No API change expected."
tina: we'll republish during the window and re-run the eu mirror job, then unpin and promote the new digest
sam: CI owners: don't re-run the eu publish job until INF-9002 is resolved or we're in the window
ina: (ops) FYI I'll monitor requests/latency for eu gateways after the pin
release-bot: reminder: include INF ticket link and changelog entry before closing thread
sam: closing for now. reopen if metrics alert
tina: :thumbsup:
